Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MS.
We generated $1.4 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $16.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2023.
Our cloud segment grew 4% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We generated $1.4 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 4% to 29% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
